description.value: Small 12-site BC Parks campground on the shore of Vaseux Lake in the warm, dry Okanagan — an area known for birding and bighorn sheep. The gate closes off-season but walk-in camping from the gate is permitted with no services provided.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a BC Parks campground (capacity 12) operated by Quality Recreation Ltd., with an official BC Parks URL that was successfully fetched. However, the fetched content is almost entirely site-wide navigation menu text with no park-specific amenity details; all subpages returned 404. OSM confirms internet_access=no. No amenity specifics can be confirmed from the website content, so nearly all optional amenities are null. The 'Book camping' navigation element appears site-wide and cannot be attributed specifically to this campground.
concerns: Fetched website content is almost entirely site-wide navigation menu with no park-specific amenity information; all subpages returned 404. No amenities could be confirmed from the website.

OSM lists operator as Quality Recreation Ltd. with email info@explorebcparks.ca, but the website URL points to the BC government domain (env.gov.bc.ca). Phone number could not be corroborated from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campground with a live official government website; a valid fee-based overnight option for touring cyclists in the South Okanagan.
